manual.warlockery.biomes_extended.title: Book of Biomes, Extended Edition
manual.warlockery.biomes_extended.overvi: A place is more than soil beneath the boot. Plains, Sunflower Plains, Meadows, Cherry Groves, Forests, Flower Forests, Birch Forests, Old Growth Birch Forests, Dark Forests, Pale Gardens, Taigas, Old Growth Pine Taigas, Old Growth Spruce Taigas, Bamboo Jungles, Jungles, and Sparse Jungles carry the green breath. Swamps, Mangrove Swamps, Rivers, Frozen Rivers, Beaches, Snowy Beaches, Stony Shores, Oceans, Cold Oceans, Frozen Oceans, Lukewarm Oceans, Warm Oceans, and their deep waters answer to tide and mist. Deserts, Savannas, Savanna Plateaus, Windswept Savannas, Badlands, Wooded Badlands, and Eroded Badlands remember sun and drought. Windswept Hills, Windswept Forests, Windswept Gravelly Hills, Groves, Snowy Slopes, Jagged Peaks, Frozen Peaks, Stony Peaks, Snowy Plains, Ice Spikes, Snowy Taigas, Mushroom Fields, Dripstone Caves, Lush Caves, and the Deep Dark keep stranger tempers below or above. The Nether holds Nether Wastes, Soul Sand Valleys, Crimson Forests, Warped Forests, and Basalt Deltas. The End divides into Highlands, Midlands, Barrens, Small End Islands, and the central End. These are the known spirits of place.
manual.warlockery.biomes_extended.biome_: Only this extended volume can bottle a landscape in ink. Carry paper, crouch, and use the book upon an exposed block in the biome to be remembered. The paper becomes a Biome Note bearing that place's true name, including lands revealed by other realms. Read its name before leaving; a note remembers the place, not the weather that happened to pass over it.
manual.warlockery.biomes_extended.shifti: Place the recorded Biome Note among the offerings for the Rite of Shifting Seasons and prepare the chalk shown by the ritual browser. A living nearby altar must hold the demanded power. The rite consumes its offerings and changes the biome around the circle to the recorded land. Rain and foliage may take a moment to heed the new spirit, and creatures already present are not replaced.
manual.warlockery.codex.title: The Warlock's Cauldron Codex
manual.warlockery.codex.custom_brews: Set the Runed Cauldron over fire, fill it with water, and let a living altar feed it power. Ingredients are vows and must enter in their written order. Ordinary brews may heal, harm, strengthen, hasten, slow, conceal, reveal, nourish, poison, freeze, burn, push, pull, till, harvest, grow, prune, fell trees, call animals, repel them, or trouble vampires, werewolves, demons, insects, and undead. Greater brews can raise land or dead, part water or lava, transpose ore, spread vines, webs, snow, thorns, blight, disease, fear, love, storms of bats, murderous flocks, endless water, moonlight, and stranger alterations. Consult the recipe display for the exact ordered ingredients of a named draught; the cauldron itself judges the sequence.
manual.warlockery.codex.circle_brewing:
Chalk laid level with the Runed Cauldron can temper a batch. The small 5x5 ring needs 12 marks:
.RRR.
R...R
R.C.R
R...R
.RRR.
The medium 9x9 ring needs 24 marks:
..IIIII..
.I.....I.
I.......I
I.......I
I...C...I
I.......I
I.......I
.I.....I.
..IIIII..
Ritual Chalk steadies the cauldron and reduces mishap risk. Infernal Chalk raises potency but invites a mishap. The two sizes may use different chalk, but every mark within one ring must be the same type. A broken or mixed ring grants nothing, and the writing above the cauldron names the fault.
manual.warlockery.codex.delivery: A finished draught may be drunk, thrown, dispersed as gas, spread as liquid, or bound to a device. Wool of Bat makes gas and Wormwood makes liquid. A Zombie Head binds the mixture to a button, lever, door, or pressure plate, where each later activation spends one stored charge on the creature using it.
manual.warlockery.codex.diagnostics: The writing above the cauldron is its confession. It names missing water, heat, altar power, the next expected ingredient, a wrong ingredient, a ruined sequence, a blocked output, and finished work. A green check means every present condition is satisfied. Remove a mistaken addition before continuing when the vessel permits it; otherwise empty the failed batch and begin again. Hoppers and compatible item or fluid pipes may serve the cauldron, but automation does not excuse the order of ingredients.
manual.warlockery.immortal.title: Observations of an Immortal
manual.warlockery.immortal.initiation: The night does not grant immortality to a solitary petitioner. First find Nami, a gentle mortal whose fate has not been joined to another. She may accept a handfasting while she remains herself. Beneath the full moon, the Blood Audience turns that tenderness into the fierce immortal called Naamah. Naamah cannot be wed. The later observations remain sealed until each Torn Page is restored to this volume.
manual.warlockery.immortal.blood: Blood is the immortal's second hunger and second heart. The reserve sustains vampire protections and powers, while the ordinary hunger bar still governs mortal exertion. Feed from valid living prey when the opportunity permits, drink Warm Blood, or draw upon a Blood Crucible. The reserve is shown beside other supernatural effects. Spending the last drop leaves the vampire alive but exposed, so hunt before invoking costly gifts.
manual.warlockery.immortal.weaknesses: Sunlight strips away the night's shelter and burns an uncovered vampire. Fire, Holy Bolts, Stake Bolts, a Wooden Stake driven into a sleeping heart, Silver Bolts, silver weapons, garlic wards, and a charged Sun Grenade can pass protections that blunt common steel. Coffins offer proper daytime rest. Vampire Hats, Coats, Chain Coats, Pants, Skirted Pants, and Boots are garments of station, not permission to ignore every weakness. Werewolf Hunters and pillagers carrying silver crossbow ammunition can also finish supernatural quarry. To abandon the blood, bind the vampire's sympathetic imprint and complete the Rite of Hexbreaking: Vampirism.
manual.warlockery.immortal.vampire_level: Level 1: The Blood Audience
manual.warlockery.immortal.nami.title: Nami, Before the Flame
manual.warlockery.immortal.nami: Seek Nami before seeking Naamah. She is mortal, mild of heart, and found beneath the ordinary sky rather than called from it. If her hand is unpromised, Nami alone may enter a marriage vow. Guard that choice carefully: once the Blood Audience remakes her, Naamah remembers the bond no more and will accept no wedding ring.
manual.warlockery.immortal.blood_audienc: Bring an unmarried Nami within the circles when the moon is wholly full. Trace twelve marks of Ritual Chalk, sixteen of Infernal Chalk, and eight of Veil Chalk. Lay down a Necromantic Stone, a Drop of Luck, a Wither Rose, and a Ghast Tear, then wake five thousand measures of altar power. The circle does not summon a stranger: it burns away Nami's mortality and names what rises Naamah. Stand ready, for her first immortal breath is wrath.
manual.warlockery.immortal.vampire_level: When the Blood Audience closes and Naamah rises, survive her wrath and accept the blood she leaves behind. The first draught wakes Blood Sense and teaches the living pulse to answer your hunger. Your new second heart holds 750 measures. The sun, flame, garlic, stakes, holy shot, and silver still know how to end you.
Level 2: The Brimming Chalice

Bind the first Torn Page into these leaves, then fill all 750 measures of your second heart from living prey, Warm Blood, or a Blood Crucible. A brimming reserve opens the fixed gaze called Transfix and parts common darkness with Night Vision. Thereafter the heart may hold 1,000.
Level 3: Five Deep Draughts

Restore the second Torn Page. Mark five different villagers with a deep draught, taking more than half from each yet leaving every vessel alive. Repeated feeding from one throat teaches nothing. When five crimson memories remain distinct, the dead hand learns supernatural Knockback and the reserve deepens to 1,250.
Level 4: Four Sleepless Dawns

With the first three Torn Pages restored, carry this book through four whole nights without surrendering to bed or death. On the fourth dawn, the long vigil flowers into Vampiric Speed, swift whenever blood is worth spending. The reserve grows to 1,500.
Level 5: The False Suns

The fourth Torn Page speaks of false suns. While true daylight sleeps, loose ten charged Sun Grenades close enough to scorch your own cold flesh. Endure every flare. The ordeal awakens Resist Sun, a tempering rather than a cure, and opens 1,750 measures of blood.
Level 6: Hearts of Flame

Set the fifth Torn Page in place and carry its cold words into the Nether. Extinguish twenty Blazes by your own violence. Their broken fire hardens the elder hand until Smash Stone may sunder common rock without a tool. The second heart holds 2,000.
Level 7: The Matriarch's Poppy

After restoring the sixth Torn Page, lead another unmarried Nami through the Blood Audience. Face the Naamah who emerges and lay a poppy before her when the struggle is won. Mercy amid ruin loosens the body's borders, granting Batswarm Form while blood remains. The reserve reaches 2,250.
Level 8: The Four Steeples

The seventh Torn Page charts four steeples beneath one flight. Become the swarm and cross the hearts of four distinct villages without touching earth between them. The voices below will then yield to Mesmerize for a little while, and the reserve widens to 2,500.
Level 9: The Measured Harvest

Restore the eighth Torn Page. Secure five different villagers in sound cages, boats, or minecarts, and drink roughly half from each without claiming a life. Such measured hunger teaches Create Vampire, the grave privilege of sharing the blood curse. Your reserve holds 2,750.
Level 10: Sire of the Long Night

When all nine Torn Pages are whole, choose a mortal with care. Mesmerize the vessel, drain it utterly, offer a goblet of its maker's blood, and keep a coffin near until the new immortal rises. The perfected sire commands Call Storm, Teleport, Call Bats, and the fearful respect of zombies. The final reserve holds 3,000.
manual.warlockery.biomes.title: Book of Biomes
manual.warlockery.biomes.overview: A biome is the kind of land around you. These chapters introduce familiar lands. The book can also remember any registered biome you visit, even when that land has no chapter here.
manual.warlockery.biomes.biome_notes: Crouch and use the Book of Biomes on a block to bind the book to that biome. Its name changes so you can see what it remembers. Use the bound book in the Rite of Shifting Seasons. The rite starts at 1 by 1 chunks, or 3 by 3 with a Seer Stone and coven. Up to three consumed Nether Stars each add one ring. The book is kept.
manual.warlockery.conjuration.title: Warlockery: Conjuration and Fetishes
manual.warlockery.conjuration.summoning: Conjuration opens a courteous door, even when what waits beyond has no courtesy. The circle rites can call a Familiar Cat, Familiar, Circle Mage, Witch, Imp, Demon, Banshee, Poltergeist, Spectre, Lost Soul, Parasytic Louse, Storm Simian, Echo Shade, Naamah, Thorned Pursuer, Forgewarden, Stonebroker, Wither, or other named being. Each has its own indexed rite in Circle Magic. A summoned creature is not automatically tame. Familiars must be bound, demons answer contracts or an Infernal Animus, spectral creatures may be held in a Spectral Stone, and hostile beings arrive ready to defend themselves.
manual.warlockery.conjuration.fetishes: A fetish is a fixed body given a roaming purpose. Bind a Scarecrow or Trent Effigy with the Rite of Binding: Fetish and the spectral offerings named by its ritual display. Bound modes can ward an area, watch for intruders, or carry sympathetic protections according to the inserted focus. Dream Weavers hang above sleeping places and shape dreams by their chosen weave. Patron statues accept a sympathetic binding and offerings of gold or goblinite; the Alluring Skull draws attention; the Statue of Broken Hexes cleanses active hexes; ritual inhibitors such as Void Bramble obstruct nearby circles. Dolls are smaller fetishes. Bind them to yourself with use in the air or to another through a Sympathetic Vial. Their durability pays for protection, mending, transferred harm, or hexing. A Doll Shelf accepts only dolls and sympathetic vessels, keeps its chunk awake, and lets bound dolls protect an owner who has travelled far away.
manual.warlockery.circles.title: Warlockery: Circle Magic
manual.warlockery.circles.chalk: Ritual Chalk draws the pale lines of mortal change, binding, weather, growth, protection, and common summoning. Infernal Chalk draws orange lines for flame, demons, the Nether, and violent transformation. Veil Chalk draws hidden roads for spirits, death, dreams, concealment, and transposition. Golden Chalk marks a circle's ritual heart; crouch while placing it to draw an ordinary golden ring mark instead. Use a Seer Stone upon that golden center to call every living Circle Mage you recruited who remains loaded, even in another realm. The mages gather around the circle and count alongside players toward coven requirements; unbound Circle Mages do not count. Place chalk like redstone dust: neighboring marks join, corners bend, and separate rings remain distinct. The rites indexed after these first lessons list exactly how many marks of each kind they require. Glyphic Transformation rites can recolor an existing outer ring when rebuilding it by hand would break the working.
manual.warlockery.circles.ritual_ui: Use an Arcane Focus on the still center of the chalk pattern. Search or scroll through the indexed rites, select one, and read every line in its accounting. The browser reports each chalk count, dropped ingredient, creature or sacrifice, nearby structure, dimension, moon phase, weather, time, coven member, bound imprint, waystone, and altar requirement. A green check beside every line means the rite may begin. A red or incomplete line describes what is absent. The floating display repeats the chosen rite's state without covering the sky; only the center speaks for the whole multiblock, so adjoining chalk cannot spam duplicate notices.
manual.warlockery.circles.power: A living altar of six joined blocks must stand close enough to hear the circle. Leaves, logs, flowers, crops, candelabra, chalices, pentacles, and other fitting surroundings enlarge its reserve and recovery. A Ritual Knife placed upon the altar focuses its reach and can be reclaimed with crouch-use. Attuned Stones carry power between workings. Ingredients should be dropped near the center and remain until casting starts. Breaking chalk, the center, or the altar cancels an active session safely. Portable rites first bind a prepared pattern into a Circle Talisman; the talisman can restore or power the compatible portable form where a permanent circle would be unwise.
manual.warlockery.circles.werewolf_level: Level 1: The First Moon

Trial: accept the werewolf hex beneath a full moon. Until mastery comes, the full moon forces the wolf shape upon you. Reward: supernatural resilience and immunity to mundane poison and disease awaken with the beast.
Level 2: The Gilded Leash

Trial: offer three Gold Ingots together upon a Wolf Altar while the moon is full. Reward: the Moon Charm permits a willing change between human and wolf, and sheep killed in wolf shape yield the mutton demanded by the next trial.
Level 3: The Shepherd's Reckoning

Trial: hunt sheep while in your four-legged wolf shape only, gather thirty Raw Mutton from those hunts, and offer all thirty upon the Wolf Altar. Reward: only that four-legged wolf shape tears quickly through dirt, sand, and similar earth, sometimes uncovering old bones. Wolfman shape gains no digging boon.
Level 4: The Red Feast
Trial: place ten Tongues of Dog upon the Wolf Altar. Reward: Feast restores health, hunger, and saturation when the transformed beast feeds upon a fresh kill.
Level 5: Hunt the Huntsman

Trial: summon or find a Thorned Pursuer and kill it with your own transformed claws. Reward: the Horn of the Hunt answers, and the Moon Charm may call the upright wolfman shape as well as the four-footed wolf.
Level 6: The Running Claw

Trial: while in wolf or wolfman form, land the killing blow upon ten hostile creatures while airborne, then return to the Wolf Altar. Reward: Running Claw turns a leaping attack into a crushing charge.
Level 7: Sixteen Echoes
Trial: howl in sixteen distinct regions so no two echoes rise from the same tract of land. Reward: a focused howl stuns nearby enemies and leaves them open to the pack.
Level 8: Call the Pack
Trial: in wolf shape, befriend six different wild wolves. Reward: Pack Howl calls loyal wolves to hunt beside you for a time.
Level 9: Nether Rending
Trial: enter the Nether while transformed and kill thirty Zombified Piglins. Reward: Rending Claws bite through armor and wear the victim's protection away.
Level 10: The Cursed Bite
Trial: while transformed, kill a villager or a consenting allied player. Reward: a near-fatal bite may pass lycanthropy to an unprotected mortal, creating a new member of the moonbound pack.
manual.warlockery.distilling.title: Warlockery: Distilling
manual.warlockery.distilling.inputs: Distillation separates a substance from the secret it would rather keep. The Distillery accepts only the items and fluids named by its recipe. Known workings refine Condensed Fear, Diamond Vapor, Ender Dew, Infernal Blood, Whiff of Magic, Refined Evil, and Oil of Vitriol. Insert the full measured input and leave valid empty output spaces; an iron sword or unrelated trinket has no business in the still and is refused.
manual.warlockery.distilling.outputs: Condensed Fear is dread made weighable. Diamond Vapor carries a gem's unyielding clarity. Ender Dew beads where distance folds. Infernal Blood keeps a demon's heat. Whiff of Magic is raw craft made scent. Refined Evil is malice stripped of noise. Oil of Vitriol is the biting spirit of mineral acid. Some workings return more than one product, so every required output slot must be clear before the still begins. Its floating words identify the missing input, fluid, vessel, power, blocked result, and progress.
manual.warlockery.distilling.automation: Hoppers and fitted pipes may feed accepted ingredients and draw finished products. Pumps may fill or drain recipes that call for fluids. Each face honors the vessel within, and no mechanism can force an invalid trinket into storage. A redstone comparator may observe the work. If an unattended still stops, read its single floating display before dismantling it; breaking one part must never multiply displays or leave phantom work behind.
manual.warlockery.herbology.title: Warlockery: Herbology
manual.warlockery.herbology.crops: A warlock's garden is a calendar written in roots. Water Artichoke favors wet ground and yields artichoke. Belladonna gives the poisonous herb behind many brews. Mandrake roots wake angrily when harvested. Dreamroot is born from a minedrake mutation and its bulbs may hunt the careless. Snowbell offers Icy Needles. Wolfsbane troubles lycanthropes and serves their rites. Wormwood and its seeds favor spirit and brewing work. Garlic grows into both food and a vampire ward. Beyond the beds, Ember Moss burns at a touch, Glint Weed shines, Spanish Moss hangs, Somnian Cotton gathers dreams, Leaping Lilies stir water, Blood Roses drink violence, and Bramble, Void Bramble, Grasspers, Pitgrass, and Critter Snares each have narrower uses.
manual.warlockery.herbology.mutations: Mutandis persuades living blocks into neighboring forms; Mutandis Extremis reaches rarer outcomes. A Mutating Sprig is the ritual hand for prepared mutations. Grasspers hold catalysts where a full circle would be too coarse. Toad and Dreamroot transformations require an exact arrangement around a cobweb over water, living participants, and charged ingredients. The floating display names each missing snare, crop, catalyst, creature, charge, or position and shows a green check only when the living diagram is complete.
manual.warlockery.herbology.toad_mutatio: Toad mutation: use the Sprig on a cobweb over water with two or more slime-filled Critter Snares, four diagonal Grasspers holding three Mutandis Extremis and one charged Attuned Stone, and a nearby cat or ocelot. One Toad forms for every filled snare.
manual.warlockery.herbology.minedrake_mu: Dreamroot mutation: place four mature Mandrakes on the cardinal rays and four diagonal Grasspers holding two Mutandis Extremis, Focused Will, and a charged Attuned Stone around a cobweb over water. Bring a Creeper and a living Mandrake, then use the Sprig to change all four crops.
manual.warlockery.herbology.minedrake_bu: A dropped Dreamroot Bulb wakes after about three seconds and hunts its dropper or the nearest survival player. Plant bulbs directly when you want a crop instead.
manual.warlockery.herbology.safe_harvest: Harvest spiteful herbs with a Boline. Its crescent edge parts stem from spirit and quiets the plant's last defense while still losing ordinary tool durability. Shears suit mosses and hanging growth where their block rules allow. Plant Dreamroot Bulbs instead of dropping them when a crop is desired, keep distance from waking Mandrakes, do not step bare upon Ember Moss, and remember that Void Bramble inhibits nearby rituals as surely as it catches flesh.
manual.warlockery.infusions.title: Warlockery: Brews and Infusions
manual.warlockery.infusions.paths: An infusion carves a road through its bearer. Earth grants endurance and command of stone. Sky grants flight and mastery of open air. Infernal grants protection from flame and kinship with Nether fire. Light grants radiant sight. The Veil grants otherworldly speed and passage near spirits. The Grave Brew attunes its drinker to death, while the Brew of Soaring steadies an enchanted broom, improves turning, and makes mounted flight more forgiving. Each path has its own circle entry following the opening lessons in Circle Magic.
manual.warlockery.infusions.focus: The Arcane Focus is both pointer and intent. Use it upon the center of a circle to choose a rite; use it upon yourself, another creature, or a compatible block to direct the selected magical path. It also handles ritual diagnostics without consuming chalk. Object infusions create the Enchanted Broom, Crystal Ball, Infernal Mirror, Mystic Branch, and Seer Stone. These are transformations of real objects, so place every named base item and reagent near the circle before beginning.
manual.warlockery.infusions.reserve: Every working spends the path's reserve, shown in the supernatural status panel. The Rite of Infusion Recharge restores reserve to practitioners inside its circle by consuming altar power. A charged Attuned Stone can help move power to the altar but does not replace personal reserve. When a working refuses to answer, check the selected path, remaining reserve, target, and ritual accounting before blaming the focus.
manual.warlockery.fumes.title: Warlockery: Collecting Fumes
manual.warlockery.fumes.oven: The Alchemical Oven draws virtue from wood, saplings, herbs, and other fitting organic matter. Ordinary logs and saplings yield Wood Ash or useful fumes; Alder, Hawthorn, and Rowan materials may release their own essences; prepared plants can yield Breath of the Goddess or Hint of Rebirth; raw pork may be altered by its proper recipe. Supply valid fuel, the recipe input, and room for every result. Its one floating display reports heat, jars, ingredients, outputs, and progress.
manual.warlockery.fumes.jars: Shape a Soft Clay Jar from Minecraft clay, then fire it until it takes the warm color of terracotta. An empty fired jar cools a hot fume without surrendering it and bears a label suited to the captured substance. Keep enough jars available before lighting the oven. Jarred reagents are ingredients, not generic storage, and machines reject a jar whose contents do not match the recipe.
manual.warlockery.fumes.funnels: A Fume Funnel catches what the oven would otherwise lose. A Filtered Fume Funnel uses a Fume Filter to favor the intended essence and improve useful recovery. The Sun Collector is a different instrument: under unobstructed daylight it charges a Quartz Sphere into a Sun Grenade. A Distillery separates prepared matter into Condensed Fear, Diamond Vapor, Ender Dew, Infernal Blood, Whiff of Magic, Refined Evil, or Oil of Vitriol. Funnels, collectors, ovens, and stills accept hoppers, pipes, and pumps only where their vessels permit it.
manual.warlockery.symbology.title: Warlockery: Symbology
manual.warlockery.symbology.focus: The Arcane Focus fixes intention upon a circle, creature, block, or the bearer. At a chalk center it opens the indexed ritual browser. On compatible targets it directs infusions, bindings, necromancy, and other focused work. The Mystic Branch carries direct click-cast signs without requiring remembered mouse gestures. Both spend the reserve of their selected path and fail harmlessly when no valid target or power remains.
manual.warlockery.symbology.gestures: Waystones remember places; Blooded Waystones and creature-bound stones add sympathy. The Rite of Binding records a circle or location, Copy Waystone duplicates a destination, and Transposition carries a creature or caster to the matching bond. A Sympathetic Vial records a creature identity for dolls, compasses, statues, and rites. The Player Compass follows its bound player even across dimensions, while the Doll Shelf Compass seeks the nearest compatible shelf. Water and Lava Diviners answer to their named fluids. A Seer Stone reads supernatural state and coven matters; a Crystal Ball reads weather, moon, progression, and bound destinations.
manual.warlockery.symbology.deflection: A ward succeeds through likeness and a tool through honest limits. The Replication Staff copies only a bounded safe selection into clear space and consumes Replication Charges. The Ritual Knife rests visibly upon an altar to focus range and returns with crouch-use. Circle Talismans carry prepared glyph patterns. Attuned Stones carry altar power. Necromantic and Spectral Stones command or contain the dead. Infernal Mirrors hold an Echo Shade until its summoning rite. If a focus shows no result, inspect its binding, charge, selected path, target type, dimension, and the nearby floating diagnostic before repeating the gesture.
manual.warlockery.torn_page.title: Torn Page
manual.warlockery.torn_page.immortal_fra: The torn hand writes of a moon made red by invitation: call the Naamah beneath a full moon, defeat what answers, and offer her blood to another Matriarch. This fragment reveals no further secret by itself. Carry it with Observations of an Immortal and use the page to restore the next missing passage of that volume.
manual.warlockery.codex.antidotes.title: Countering Venom
manual.warlockery.codex.antidotes: A Universal Antidote is worked from a Null Catalyst, a Brew of Infection, and a Brew of Wasting. Drinking it draws out poison and wither without stripping helpful enchantments or blessings.

manual.warlockery.conjuration.fetish_sca: A Scarecrow becomes a bound fetish through twelve Ritual Chalk marks, twelve Infernal Chalk marks, 2,200 altar power, the Scarecrow, three Spectral Dust, and a spectral creature within the circle. A Lost Soul grants Voodoo Protection, a Banshee grants Shrieking, a Spectre grants Sentinel, a Poltergeist grants Disorientation, and another spectral being grants Ghost Walking. Place the resulting Scarecrow, use a configuration focus to cycle its mode or awaken it, and use an empty hand to read its state.
manual.warlockery.conjuration.fetish_tre: The Trent Effigy is a wooden promise offered to the forest. Place it on firm ground and present a sapling, flower, or seed. A valid offering is consumed and an Ent wakes above the effigy, shaped by the land in which it is called.
manual.warlockery.conjuration.fetish_dre: Hang this pale weave within eight blocks of the bed. After a full sleep it leaves regeneration upon the waking body. A nearby nightmare weave can sour that blessing into poison unless protective dream plants stand watch.

The green weave gathers the memory of a feast. Sleep beside it and wake with hunger and saturation restored. A Weaver of Intensity strengthens the meal, while an unwarded nightmare twists fullness into ravenous hunger.

The blue weave teaches sleeping feet to remember the wind. A proper night's rest grants Speed; an Intensity weave sharpens it, while an unwarded nightmare leaves the limbs heavy with Slowness and Weakness.

The magenta weave is an amplifier, best hung beside another helpful pattern. It strengthens Fasting, Fleet Foot, and Iron Arm dreams and grants Night Vision when it is the nearest weave to the bed. Nightmare corruption still overrules its aid.

The silver-gray weave fills the waking arms with industrious force, granting Haste after a full sleep. Intensity hones that strength. An unwarded nightmare answers instead with Mining Fatigue and Weakness.

The black weave turns sleep against every nearby blessing. One brings Weakness; two deepen the visitation with Blindness. Protective dream plants catch the malice and return Absorption instead, so ward the bed before hanging it.
manual.warlockery.conjuration.fetish_all: The Alluring Skull calls susceptible creatures from sixteen blocks away. Place it where the path is safe, use a compatible activating focus to awaken or quiet it, and inspect it with an empty hand. While active it sheds soul motes and continually draws valid creatures toward its jaw.
manual.warlockery.conjuration.fetish_sta: The Goddess Statue is a cleansing fetish. Use it while burdened by an active hex and it strips the hostile bindings from you. If no hex answers, the statue reports that there is nothing to cleanse and remains ready for a later supplicant.

Bind the Statue of Worship to a living target before placing it. A valid patron offering of gold or goblinite calls Luck II and Haste I upon that bound target for two minutes. Using an empty hand reveals whose sympathy the statue carries.

The Statue of Broken Hexes is a direct cleansing fetish. Touch it while carrying one or more hexes and every active hex is severed. It consumes no offering, but it has no effect when no baneful bond is present.

The Statue of Occluded Summons guards a place against circle work. Use it with an empty hand to awaken or quiet its ward. An active statue inhibits nearby rituals, so keep it away from your own chalk unless you intend to bar every working in its reach.
manual.warlockery.conjuration.fetish_dol: A Doll Shelf accepts only dolls and sympathetic vessels. It keeps its own chunk awake, allowing stored bound dolls to answer their owner from afar. Use the shelf screen to read its bindings and remove a doll before its remaining durability is spent.
manual.warlockery.conjuration.sympatheti: A Sympathetic Vial may take an imprint directly from a living creature, from a Blood Rose or Leech Chest, or from the claimed bed of a sleeping player. Its name and glow reveal a successful binding.
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_artich: Water Artichoke favors cultivated wet ground. Harvest the mature crop for Artichoke, a cooling garden reagent used in brews and preparations that draw upon water and living growth.
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_bellad: Belladonna is the poisoner of the garden. Its mature leaves enter harmful brews, mutating compounds, and rites that need a living herb with a baneful nature. Keep it planted until fully grown for the best yield.
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_garlic: Garlic is both crop and ward. Harvest it for cookery and brewing, braid it into a Garlic Garland, or carry it into vampire work. Vampires burn when they press against a proper garlic ward.
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_mandra: Mandrake yields a potent root for rites, brews, and mutations, but a mature plant wakes when broken and rises as a hostile Mandrake. A Boline quiets dangerous harvests. Mature Mandrakes also form the cardinal roots of the Dreamroot mutation.
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_dreamr: Dreamroot is born through the prepared Mandrake mutation. Its harvest feeds dream magic and yields bulbs. Plant a bulb to continue the crop; a bulb dropped loose wakes after a few breaths and hunts the nearest survival player.
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_snowbe: Snowbell stores winter in a living stem. Its mature harvest supplies Icy Needles and other cold-aligned reagents for freezing brews, protective equipment, and workings that call frost without ordinary ice.
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_wolfsb: Wolfsbane is cultivated wherever lycanthropes are hunted or cured. Its harvest belongs in werewolf rites, hunter preparations, and brews intended to trouble the beast within.
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_wormwo: Wormwood is a bitter bridge to spirits. Save both herb and seed for spectral brews, fumigation, and rites concerned with the dead or the veil. A mature bed provides the dependable supply these workings consume.
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_ember_: Ember Moss spreads slowly across compatible ground and shines with banked heat. Living creatures that cross it without protection may ignite. Use it as a warning carpet, a fiery reagent, or a source of warm occult light.
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_glint_: Glint Weed is a bright, self-spreading herb that thrives on compatible ground. It gives strong natural light without flame and serves wherever a working calls for luminous living growth.
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_spanis: Spanish Moss hangs rather than stands. Let it trail from a suitable support and harvest it with care for weaving, hanging charms, and recipes that need a soft plant fiber touched by damp air.
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_somnia: Somnian Cotton gathers the residue of sleep. At night or during a waking nightmare it yields Disturbed Cotton, the fiber used for dream-bound threads and protective weaves. In ordinary daylight it remains dormant.
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_leapin: Leaping Lilies favor water gardens. A creature brushing their leaves receives a brief blessing of speed and strengthened jumping. Plant them along safe crossings or harvest them for motion-aligned brewing.
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_blood_: The Blood Rose answers violence and blood-bound craft. Grow it apart from peaceful beds and reserve its petals for vampire work, blood reagents, and rites where a living flower must remember harm.
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_brambl: Bramble is a thorned living barrier. It slows a careless path, supplies thorn-aligned ingredients, and suits defensive gardens where an ordinary fence would carry no magical sympathy.
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_void_b: Void Bramble catches flesh and stills nearby ritual power. Plant it to deny hostile circles or protect a threshold, but keep it well beyond your own chalk before beginning a rite.
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_grassp: A Grassper holds one offered item visibly above its leaves and returns it when used again. Four diagonal Grasspers serve as ingredient pedestals in advanced living mutations, including the rites that create Toads and Dreamroot.
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_pitgra: Pitgrass disguises prepared pit ground with a grassy face. Use it in concealed garden traps and defensive paths where ordinary grass would reveal the hollow beneath.
manual.warlockery.herbology.plant_critte: A Critter Snare captures a compatible small creature that steps into it and preserves that creature when the block is moved. Filled Slime snares are living ingredients in the Toad mutation; an empty hand releases a stored creature.

manual.warlockery.circles.veil_waystones: For a place-binding, draw an exact hollow 3 by 3 ring of eight Veil Chalk marks and drop one to eight plain Waystones into its empty heart. If exactly one Waystone shares the ring with a living creature, the working takes that creature's imprint instead and demands 1600 power. For passage, draw an exact 5 by 5 perimeter with twelve Veil Chalk marks, leaving all four corners blank. Drop a position-bound Waystone at its heart and gather living travellers and loose items inside the inner 3 by 3 space. The circle takes 1000 altar power and carries them to safe ground at the remembered place. An active ritual inhibitor at either end, obstructed ground, or a destination in another realm prevents passage. Chalk and offerings endure; pick up and drop a stone again to retry a failed working.

manual.warlockery.conjuration.spirit_wor: Eat a Sleeping Apple to force a nightmare, or fall asleep under a Sleeping Brew, which begins with a ninety-five percent nightmare risk. Your sleeping body remains where you fell. Only a Nightmare Dream Weaver within eight blocks changes the odds: one Weaver subtracts fifty points, each Flowing Spirit subtracts ten up to three, and each Wispy Cotton subtracts ten up to two. Each Demon Heart adds thirty-five up to two, and each fire adds ten up to three. The final risk remains between zero and ninety-five percent.

Only Icy Needles and Verdant Catalysts cross into the dream. On waking, your original inventory returns and only surviving carry-ins or approved dream harvests come home, so nothing is copied. Use an Icy Needle or the Spirit Portal to wake. Destruction of your sleeping body or a mortal dream wound wakes you before death. Circle Magic cannot be cast beyond this boundary.

Wispy Cotton and free spirits gather sparingly near dreamers. Nightmares stain cotton into Disturbed Cotton. Icy Needles, both Verdant Catalysts, Wispy or Disturbed Cotton, Mellifluous Hunger, Congealed Spirit, Spirit Buckets, and Flowing Spirit may be carried home. Verdant Catalysts also reveal dream-only transformations, and Flowing Spirit can be made in a cauldron only here.

An ordinary nightmare darkens the sky and sends a Nightmare to hunt the dreamer. For the rarer demonic nightmare, sleep under a Sleeping Brew within eight blocks of a Dream Weaver set to Nightmares, Flowing Spirit, and a placed Demon Heart. That complete arrangement has an eight percent chance to call demons and harmless fiery rain. A Sleeping Apple forces an ordinary nightmare but never the demonic kind.

manual.warlockery.preamble.title: What This Book Teaches
manual.warlockery.biomes_extended.preamb: Every land has a spirit. This book teaches you how to remember a biome and use that memory in the Rite of Shifting Seasons. Read the first lessons, then open the chapter named for the land you want.
manual.warlockery.biomes_extended.overvi: A biome is the kind of land around you. These chapters introduce familiar lands. The book can also remember any registered biome you visit, even when that land has no chapter here.
manual.warlockery.biomes_extended.biome_: Crouch and use this book on a block in the biome you want to remember. The book keeps that biome and adds its name to the book's own name. Binding a new place replaces the old memory. No paper is needed.
manual.warlockery.biomes_extended.shifti: Bring the named, biome-bound book to the Rite of Shifting Seasons. A plain rite begins with the center chunk. A Seer Stone and the needed coven empower it to begin with a 3 by 3 square. Each Nether Star adds one more ring, and no more than three may be used. The sizes are 1, 3, 5, or 7 chunks wide without empowerment and 3, 5, 7, or 9 with it. The bound book is kept, but every offered Nether Star is consumed.
manual.warlockery.codex.preamble: This is a guide to cauldron brews. It shows how to heat the pot, add ingredients in order, and choose how the finished brew is used. Every brew has its own page with its power and recipe.
manual.warlockery.codex.custom_brews: Put the Runed Cauldron over fire. Fill it with water and keep a powered altar nearby. Add each ingredient in the order shown on the brew's page. A wrong ingredient spoils the batch, so read the floating words before adding the next one.
manual.warlockery.codex.delivery: You may drink or throw a finished brew. Wool of Bat turns it into a gas. Wormwood turns it into a liquid pool. A Zombie Head binds it to a button, lever, door, or pressure plate, and each use spends one charge.
manual.warlockery.codex.diagnostics: Read the words above the cauldron. They tell you when water, heat, power, an ingredient, or output space is missing. A green check means the cauldron is ready. If the order is ruined, empty it and begin again.
manual.warlockery.immortal.preamble: This is your guide to becoming an immortal vampire. The first lessons show how to begin, but the later lessons were torn out. Hold this same book and use one Torn Page to sew in exactly one missing lesson. Add the pages one at a time as you grow stronger. Nine Torn Pages reveal the whole path, and a page cannot open any other book.
manual.warlockery.immortal.nami: Find Nami while she is still human. Only an unmarried Nami may accept your marriage ring. The Blood Audience changes her into Naamah, and Naamah cannot marry.
manual.warlockery.immortal.blood_audienc: On a full moon, bring an unmarried Nami into the circle. Use 12 Ritual Chalk, 16 Infernal Chalk, and 8 Veil Chalk. Offer a Necromantic Stone, Drop of Luck, Wither Rose, and Ghast Tear with 5,000 altar power. Nami becomes Naamah, and she wakes angry.
manual.warlockery.immortal.vampire_level: Defeat Naamah after the Blood Audience and drink the blood she leaves. You become a vampire and gain Blood Sense. Your blood reserve holds 750. Sun, fire, garlic, stakes, holy bolts, and silver can still hurt you.
Sew the first Torn Page into this book. Fill all 750 blood from prey, Warm Blood, or a Blood Crucible. You gain Transfix and Night Vision. Your new blood limit is 1,000.
Sew in the second Torn Page. Drink more than half the blood from five different villagers, but keep them alive. You gain stronger Knockback. Your new blood limit is 1,250.
Restore the first three Torn Pages. Carry this book and stay awake for four whole nights. You gain Vampiric Speed. Your new blood limit is 1,500.
Sew in the fourth Torn Page. At night, burn yourself with ten charged Sun Grenades. You gain some Sun Resistance, but daylight is still dangerous. Your new blood limit is 1,750.
Sew in the fifth Torn Page and kill 20 Blazes. You gain Smash Stone and can break common rock with empty hands. Your new blood limit is 2,000.
Sew in the sixth Torn Page. Change another unmarried Nami into Naamah, defeat her, and offer a Poppy. You gain Batswarm Form while you have blood. Your new blood limit is 2,250.
Sew in the seventh Torn Page. In Batswarm Form, visit four distinct villages without landing. You gain Mesmerize. Your new blood limit is 2,500.
Sew in the eighth Torn Page. Hold five different villagers in cages, boats, or minecarts. Drink about half from each and keep them alive. You gain Create Vampire. Your new blood limit is 2,750.

Restore all nine Torn Pages. Mesmerize a villager, drain all its blood, give it a goblet of your blood, and place a coffin nearby. When it becomes a vampire, you gain Call Storm, Teleport, Call Bats, and zombie respect. Your final blood limit is 3,000.
manual.warlockery.distilling.preamble: This book teaches how the Distillery pulls secret drops from magical things. Give it the shown ingredients, clay jars, and altar power. Each recipe page shows what goes in and what comes out.
manual.warlockery.herbology.preamble: This is a guide to the warlock's garden. Every plant has a page that says where it grows, how to harvest it, and what its magic is good for. The last lessons teach safe plant mutations.
manual.warlockery.infusions.preamble: This book teaches how to place lasting magic in a person or an object. Choose a path, gather the pictured offerings, and mind your magic reserve. Later pages show every personal and object infusion.
manual.warlockery.infusions.focus: The Arcane Focus points your magic. Use it on a circle's center to choose a rite. Use it on yourself, a creature, or a fitting block to aim an infusion. At a circle it also tells you what is missing without using any chalk.
manual.warlockery.fumes.preamble: This book teaches how to catch magical smoke. Feed the Alchemical Oven, give it fired clay jars, and leave room for every result. Each recipe page shows the input, the fume, and any ash or food left behind.
manual.warlockery.symbology.preamble: This book teaches magic held in signs, stones, branches, and foci. It explains what each tool can point at and what power it spends. Begin with the Arcane Focus, then read the page for the tool in your hand.
manual.warlockery.symbology.deflection: Each tool has one honest job. A Replication Staff copies a small safe space and spends Replication Charges. A Ritual Knife rests on an altar and returns when you crouch-use it. Talismans carry circles, Attuned Stones carry altar power, spirit stones hold the dead, and Infernal Mirrors hold an Echo Shade. If a tool does nothing, check its binding, charge, target, and the nearby floating words.
First, crouch and use a Book of Biomes on the land you want so the book remembers it. Place that named book near the circle; the rite keeps it. With no empowerment, the rite changes only the chunk holding the circle. A Seer Stone and five nearby practitioners together empower it to a 3 by 3 square. Each Nether Star adds one more ring of chunks. At most three stars are consumed, so the possible widths are 1, 3, 5, or 7 chunks normally and 3, 5, 7, or 9 when empowered.
ritual.warlockery.climate_change.descrip: Changes whole chunks to match the biome remembered by a bound Book of Biomes. A Seer Stone with five gathered practitioners and up to three Nether Stars widens the rite.
screen.warlockery.ritual.requirement.rec: A nearby Book of Biomes bound to a biome

manual.warlockery.biome.entry: %s is an unfamiliar land spirit. Visit it to study its blocks, creatures, and weather, then bind it into the Book of Biomes for the Rite of Shifting Seasons.
manual.warlockery.biome.entry.green_land: %s holds trees, grass, flowers, or fertile soil. Seek it for wood, herbs, animals, and gentle nature magic.
manual.warlockery.biome.entry.waters_and: %s holds rivers, ocean water, marshes, or shores. Seek it for fish, clay, water plants, and water magic.
manual.warlockery.biome.entry.cold_lands: %s holds snow, ice, high stone, or cold trees. Seek it for frost ingredients, mountain stone, goats, and cold magic.
manual.warlockery.biome.entry.dry_and_wi: %s holds sand, red stone, acacia, or strong wind. Seek it for dry plants, terracotta, gold, and weather magic.
manual.warlockery.biome.entry.caves_and_: %s holds deep stone, cave plants, mushrooms, sculk, or eerie emptiness. Seek it for rare ores, spores, echoes, and hidden magic.
manual.warlockery.biome.entry.nether_bio: %s is a hot and dangerous Nether land with fire, strange fungi, or soul-touched ground. Seek it for infernal ingredients and fire magic.
manual.warlockery.biome.entry.end_biomes: %s is a lonely End land with end stone, chorus growth, and the power of distance. Seek it for ender ingredients and travel magic.
manual.warlockery.machine_recipe.entry: This page teaches the %s working. Add the shown vessels and ingredients in order, supply any listed fluid or fuel, and leave room for every result.
manual.warlockery.conjuration.beast_spee: Hold a Beast-Speech Charm, offer an animal a food it likes, and use the charm on that animal. The charm lets you understand one another, so a sheep or other friendly beast may trade a gift for your offering. The Silver Tongue Charm speaks to demons instead.
manual.warlockery.biomes.preamble: Every biome has its own little spirit. This book names those places and teaches how their memory guides the Rite of Shifting Seasons. Pick a biome chapter to learn which land your magic will call.
manual.warlockery.conjuration.preamble: This book teaches how to call magical beings and wake bound charms. Each creature, doll, statue, and dream weave has its own short lesson. Read its page before you invite a strange spirit home.
manual.warlockery.circles.preamble: This book teaches circle magic. Draw the shown chalk rings, place the shown offerings, and use the golden center to begin. Pick a rite to see its picture, ingredients, altar power, and every missing step.
message.warlockery.villager.blood_draine: This villager is too blood-drained to trade.
